proposals.name: Miroslav Krejčí

proposals.headline: Bývalý šéf CERMATu vede obě klíčové bezpečnostní komise Sněmovny — hybridní hrozby i dohled nad NÚKIB — a nemá jediný vlastní tisk.

proposals.headline: Bývalý ministr zemědělství a hejtman v šestém mandátu: skóre meziobdobně stouplo z 85 na 93, ale u žádného ze čtyř tisků není první podpis.

crossCuttingLeads: Data-quality: the linkedCompanies 'OSVČ' entry with IČO 04627695 / contractCzk 0 appears identically for both Miroslav Samaš and Petr Bendl — looks like a generic placeholder entity in the source pipeline rather than a genuine personal identifier; worth a review of the OSVČ-linkage extraction before Case-① treats it as a real tie.

Sibling collision: Petr Bendl (this batch) and Karel Haas (batch 001, top5) co-sign the identical ODS club bill slate (Bendl: 103/129/208/261; Haas: 72/103/129/208/261) — this is one shared legislative package authored by Jan Bureš's group, not five independent efforts; per-MP bill_focus narratives across both batches should be read together, not as separate authorship stories.

Sibling collision: Benjamin Činčila's tisk 50 (government-opposed pension novela, 155/1995) is the same bill batch 001 credits Monika Brzesková with steering as guarantor committee chair — Činčila is a co-signer on the same KDU-ČSL bill; the merged writeup should attribute committee-guarantor credit to Brzesková and co-sponsorship to Činčila, not double-count it as two independent stories.

Quiet pattern: two of this group's five MPs (Krejčí, Samaš) are oversight-workhorses specifically in the defense/hybrid-threats/cyber domain (SKHH, SKNÚKIB, SKVZ, MO acquisitions subcommittee) rather than the healthcare/audit domains batch 001 surfaced — the app's 'oversight-institutional workhorse' label should be broad enough to cover security/defense commissions, not just NBÚ/odposlechy.
